sql: select 'owner_agent_status' as k, agent_code as a, status as b, birth_cohort_id::text as c from evo_agents where agent_uuid in ('0b112ad9-aa57-401d-ae69-e07574bf5cb3','78c73b86-6b2c-4e9b-a3e7-225a5cc26db4','0bb6dd17-f16a-49b3-8d4f-933631fb12bd') union all select 'orders_for_strategies', strategy_id::text, status, count(*)::text from evo_orders where strategy_id in (24,35,38,39,41,43,44,45) group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2
